Elevate Kids Media

A creative media initiative of Emerald Heart Group of Companies.

01 · WHO WE ARE

Creative ideas. Practical skills. Stronger communities.

Elevate Kids Media is a creative media initiative nurturing youth expression through music, art and digital storytelling. We design skill-building programmes and creative experiences that foster confidence, creativity and community.

Led by Edwin Stephen Ayittey, CEO of Emerald Heart Group of Companies, the initiative works with schools, institutions, families, organisations and other partners.
